Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.analytics

Class VerifiedAnalyticalRecipeResolver

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.analytics.VerifiedAnalyticalRecipeResolver
public class VerifiedAnalyticalRecipeResolver extends Object
Resolve, valida (fail-fast) e compila VerifiedAnalyticalRecipe declarativas e VerifiedAnalyticalRecipeDescriptor programaticas em contratos canonicos para OpenAPI x-ui.analytics.verifiedRecipes, /schemas/domain, GET /stats/recipes e execucao fail-closed em POST /stats/recipes/{recipeId}.
